entries.name: 普段着DJ・スクラッチ
entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: a single photorealistic transparent full-body cutout for a Japanese photo compositing app. Reference image 1 is the identity and body reference of elderly Japanese Kozo. Preserve his recognizable warm wrinkled face, age, gray hair, friendly smile and natural build. He is performing as a DJ. Include one realistic standalone two-deck DJ controller with two jog wheels, a central mixer, controls and a small integrated display, on a sturdy waist-height black four-legged equipment table. Include the complete table feet, the man's shoes, hands and head with clear transparent padding on all sides. Table does not hide all his legs. Slightly elevated three-quarter front view so the controller is visible. Over-ear headphones with a black cable visibly connected to the controller headphone jack, realistic length and slack. Compact black powered battery monitor beside the table on the ground with a single audio cable connecting its INPUT jack to the controller output jack at both ends. Controller is a standalone battery-powered setup: no laptop, no dangling unattached cable or plug. Authentic hand placement, five fingers per hand, no additional people. Soft neutral photographic lighting, high detail. Actual alpha transparency everywhere outside person and gear, including between table legs; no backdrop, no painted checkerboard, no glow, no opaque ground plane, no stage, no text captions or watermark. Ground contact shadow only very subtle and tight. This is a respectful cheerful photo of the same elderly man, not a younger celebrity. One coherent scene, not a collage.
Clothes: exactly the reference everyday outfit: navy fishing cap, pale sage green short-sleeve polo with left chest pocket, cream trousers, black trainers and black wristwatch on HIS LEFT wrist. Chest embroidery must read exactly two lines in navy: upper 徳島県, lower クラゲ漁業組合. Keep the chest lettering fully visible and legible. Keep recognizable face; no sunglasses.
Pose: Both headphones over ears. His right fingertips lightly touch the right jog wheel while left fingers adjust the mixer crossfader. Looking up at camera with a warm smile, gentle forward lean.

refinement.prompt: Precise object edit of this transparent cutout. Preserve EXACTLY the same person, face, clothing, pose, chest Japanese lettering, controller, table, monitor, composition and alpha background. Fix ONLY the cabling. DELETE every extra wire or dangling cable segment currently plugged into the front controller headphone sockets (the front-left/center cable ending in midair or forming a short U between two sockets). Leave those front headphone sockets EMPTY. The headphone cable already descending from the actual headphone earcup over his chest must continue naturally over the TOP of the controller and connect directly into a visible headphone jack on the TOP panel, with a right-angle plug, no free cable end. It is a single continuous wire from headphone to top panel. Preserve exactly ONE audio cable from the controller front-right output to the monitor's actual INPUT jack; it must be continuous end-to-end and correctly plugged in at both ends. If the monitor currently has duplicate wires or loops terminating behind the handle, replace with this one output-to-INPUT cable. No unrelated cable, no dangling stub, no two-jack short U patch. No other edits. Preserve real transparency and full framing.
